source_evidence: Exact player 'Lets go followup on Quenwood stuff'. Prior D325 Desen disclosure establishes actual payee and ordinary directions. Source-pinned prep/dm-only/dm-ferry-i.md @8e5df88d508d558ed0907593bb84c8c65a6741ea and dm-ferry-setup.md @300789a66801d87700502e1499b9cfbb15ff72b4, prior actual court disposition and archive/history-day-165.md. G1 coherent independent shipwright and source knowledge; G2 actual documents answer historic loss and give paymaster route regardless of independent skiff offer; G3 routine willing disclosure no roll, no monster initiative or attack until actual chosen approach. Newly played visit and daughter's grounded request; no unplayed hidden sponsor, future transaction, or new payoff asserted. D326~13:30 at identified working Orsaven boatyard on the city's main commercial river, V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar together, coach and four horses safely at Copper Hart. Player 'Lets go followup on Quenwood stuff' authorizes following Desen's actual D325 directions to the shipwright, no unchosen coercion, spending, voyage or unrelated investigation. Ordinary safe city walk, arrived~13:15. At actual routine launch proprietor's adult daughter rings once for the caulker who died in the earlier flood, workers briefly honor him. Proprietor privately receives party and daughter, voluntarily shows original receipted bill for the two original ferry hulls and signed Quenwood personal guarantee, matching Desen's independently shown pre-death4-C clearing-office payment/payee. Guarantee establishes Quenwood's promised private eighth of net evening earnings while operator held lease; flood destroyed both hulls and killed caulker trying to save one; guarantor paid outstanding installment using beneficiary reserves, source known to proprietor only from subsequent investigators, not at original receipt. Daughter hears father explain source in actual private conversation, insists yard built boats and was not aware of theft. Cirren reasonably connects original loss with Quenwood's previously established diversion and murders to conceal losses, distinguishes inference from records and no proof operator or yard knowingly involved in killings. Shipwright confirms replacement ferry operation continues, directs party to ferry paymaster at ordinary landing for current eighth-share agreement, distributions and any money retained; exact sum, recipient and restitution status remain unverified. No new hidden lace receiver/syndicate/deputy facts, forged record, ownership, confiscation or guilt attributed. Yard originals remain proprietor custody, party has supervised knowledge only, no copy removed. Essential evidence provided without check, no payment or new contract. Daughter also mentions their separate rescue skiff trapped behind sagging boom, chain jumped pin in service chamber; workers barred lower stair after seeing yellow moving slime near chain; she seeks help voluntarily, no automatic commitment, reward, hazard clock or combat activation. If V chooses approach, pin actual 2014 MM Ochre Jelly statblock and fixed geometry (quay stair, high shelf/wheel/lifting eye, dry chamber lower grating, exit into pen, creature visible20ft from pin), use existing prep and real RNG; no forced combat or extra creatures. Skiff task independent of financial evidence, may help, decline, go directly to paymaster. V has not accepted or acted on skiff. Current Ferrymen's Share goal recover funds to victims through actual evidence/lawful custody; Quenwood life imprisonment upheld, restitution unpaid. All party resources full after D326 LR: V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone; Cirren51/51 AC19 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 +1 Shield equipped old shield retained Boots of Elvenkind; Fenar59/59 AC16 HD6/6 Rage4/4 inactive Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40, breastplate and Insignia, natural attacks+9/1d6+6 base or1d6+8 raging, mechanical greataxe unchanged. Mara healthy. Purse2049gp8sp6cp, rations21/feed28, LR0/6, no payment or rest. Crown diplomatic invitation delivered, favorable recommendation and Ossent confidential copies complete, royal decision pending; Crown frontier300+1300 contingent, no new liaison. D326 conditional service-house grant signed not title; Coris packet forwarding300gp pending, optional800gp field milestone. Orders target353 with520gp unpaid; Serpent Dart unresolved. Elara Caereth, Severin assent unconfirmed. All other custody unchanged. V dice delegated. Await response to daughter or choice to proceed to paymaster.
